comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body: I wish players would get that notion out of their head that they MUST have an astros ship to be able to succeed in anything. You don't! While having one does have SOME factor and may help make things a bit easier, it's not absolute. It's all about your skill level, strategy, and experience. Know when to fight, how to overcome your opponent, and know when to retreat. And for piracy purposes, player made ships are fine. I dont know what your levels are, but at battle level 46 you can sail a Turkish Galley which makes a good pirate ship early on IMO.
